@graph.name: Hermes Agent
@graph.description: Generic OSCAR agent runtime that processes files from synchronous invocations or MinIO input events by invoking Hermes Agent with the behavior instructions supplied at deployment time.

@graph.name: OSCAR Function Definition Language file
@graph.description: Defines the OSCAR service, MinIO input and output paths, model provider variables, and OPENAI_API_KEY secret placeholder.

@graph.name: OSCAR execution script
@graph.description: Configures Hermes Agent with the selected OpenAI-compatible provider, invokes hermes chat with file and terminal tools, and writes the final response to TMP_OUTPUT_DIR.

@graph.name: Hermes agent runtime image
@graph.description: Builds a reusable runtime image from the Hermes Agent container and adds common file processing utilities.

@graph.name: Agent behavior specification
@graph.description: Human-readable behavior contract for the agent. The sample FDL passes equivalent instructions through the AGENT_SOUL environment variable.

@graph.name: Input file
@graph.description: File provided by a synchronous invocation or uploaded to the hermes-agent/input MinIO path.

@graph.name: Output result
@graph.description: Plain text result returned synchronously or stored in the hermes-agent/output MinIO path with a -result.txt suffix.

@graph.name: HERMES_PROVIDER_NAME
@graph.description: Logical provider name for the OpenAI-compatible model endpoint.

@graph.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
@graph.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API.

@graph.name: OPENAI_MODEL
@graph.description: Model name sent to the chat completions endpoint.

@graph.name: AGENT_SOUL
@graph.description: Behavior instructions passed to the agent at deployment time. The sample value mirrors SOUL.md so the same Docker image can be reused with different behaviors.

@graph.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
@graph.description: Required secret used as a bearer token for the OpenAI-compatible API. The crate intentionally contains only a placeholder.

@graph.name: File processing utilities
@graph.description: Command-line utilities available to Hermes Agent through the terminal tool.

@graph.name: Hermes Agent
@graph.description: Open-source agentic AI system by Nous Research.
